title: Post Abortion IUD & Recurrent Abortion 2001-2004
brief_summary: It has been shown that the immediate insertion of intrauterine devices (IUDs) post-abortion prevents repeat abortions. The researchers hypothesize that providing free IUDs post-abortion will be associated with a lower rate of repeat abortion in a Canadian population. Further, the researchers hypothesize that providing free IUDs post-abortion will be associated with decreased costs for the health care system.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female resident of Interior Health region seeking an abortion between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2004

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women undergoing abortions for fetal genetic abnormalities
study_population: Female resident of Interior Health region seeking an abortion
